verdict.rationale: Okta exposes REST/SCIM APIs and an MCP server with example prompts like creating a user, listing unused apps, or querying failed logins, which could be scripted to loop over many items, but there is no documented bulk/batch endpoint or explicit bulk-operation capability, and rate limits are called out as a constraint on high-volume automation. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations, documentation of bulk actions via MCP or SCIM, and evidence of high-volume automation working in practice without rate-limit friction.
